svg.text: INKLING-2-MINI TO MINIMAX-H3 IMAGE DIFFUSION · 160 SEALED CONFIRMATION PROMPTS
A 90.0 MiB linear map stands in for a 27.14 GB text encoder and keeps
97.5% of its prompt adherence margin on 160 sealed prompts
The image model normally takes its prompt from a 27.14 GB encoder. Here it takes Inkling-2-Mini hidden states, passed through a ridge map
solved in closed form with no gradient steps. Each dot is one sealed prompt; the white bar is the mean.
Does the picture match the prompt?

Does it match the teacher's picture?

source groups score above the shuffled control, for both
Development panel against the sealed set
the maps were frozen after the 24 development prompts; the 160 sealed prompts were read once
areas drawn in proportion to bytes
four-tap map, 288× smaller than the teacher
single-tap map, 1,150× smaller than the teacher
The four-tap map was fitted on 640 prompts (13,872 aligned word spans) in
355 s on CPU. It reads four hidden-state taps from Inkling-2-Mini, so that
model has to be loaded; the teacher encoder does not.
No fitting ran during confirmation. The teacher re-injection check again
reproduced the native run exactly on 4 prompts.
160 sealed confirmation prompts from 16 source groups, with statistics paired by source group. The shuffled control was fitted for the single-tap map;
the four-tap map is reported separately against the same control. 6-step sampling at 1024 by 1024, with the same seed and starting noise in every arm.
Margin kept is the map minus control, divided by teacher minus control.
